sources.snapshotNote: HTTP Last-Modified is file publication time, not an asserted OSM replication timestamp.

importNotes: Filtered complete source geometries to bounded region by intersection.
Source GeoJSON omits OSM IDs. Hash-based provider feature identifiers and source ordinals are explicit; osmId is null unless an actual source ID exists or exact core geometry matches.
Multipolygon geometry and inner holes assembled by source Osmium export, preserved without fabricated members.
All selected-feature OSM tags retained; geometric clipping and ownership happen in the tile builder.

featureIdentity.providerFeatureId: bbbike:SHA256(canonical centimetre-projected geometry + sorted OSM tags)
featureIdentity.sourceFeatureOrdinal: 1-based position in the original source FeatureCollection
featureIdentity.knownCoreMatching: Known core OSM IDs are retained only after exact canonical geometry matching in the tile builder.

coreRoadGeometryPriority.rule: For an existing core OSM way ID, retain its full core polyline, width, lanes and basic road fields in all tiles; keep additional regional bridge/tunnel/layer metadata. Also retain known core roads absent in the older regional snapshot.

naturePolygonClipping: Water, park and vegetation rings/holes are clipped to each exact tile rectangle at build time to avoid repeatedly transferring very large relation geometry.

coreGeometryMatching.method: Exact centimetre-projected line geometry, invariant to reversal; building rings invariant to rotation/reversal.
coreGeometryMatching.buildingOwnership: Buildings with centroid inside the existing core, or exact geometry matching a building rendered by the core, are omitted from streamed ownership. Other exact matches to known core outlines retain their known OSM IDs.
coreGeometryMatching.sourceIds: BBBike features lacking original OSM IDs keep osmId:null and explicit providerFeatureId/source ordinal/source URL. A content hash is never labelled as an OSM ID.

transformations: Coordinates projected to the existing local x/z metre origin and rounded to centimetres.
Real road geometries retained with original OSM IDs where available or explicit provider content identifiers otherwise; full road geometry is indexed into every intersected tile.
Multipolygon member ways stitched into closed outer rings; inner rings retained as holes. Incomplete rings are omitted and counted.
Buildings assigned once by polygon centroid; complete footprints retained. Existing core building IDs omitted from streamed geometry and kept as tree avoidance context.
Road bridge, tunnel, layer, access, surface, lane, width, oneway and maxspeed metadata retained.
Actual water and park/vegetation outlines retained. No synthetic roads or building footprints are introduced.
Building height and facade defaults are renderer assumptions when absent in OSM; this is not a photogrammetric or cadastral dataset.
